_purpose_comment: V2 production-exec paired oracle COV-A: derived from exec_oracle_replayer_sample_config.json. Diffs vs baseline: (1) target.thread_count=32 logical executor slots + kcov_collector_count=8 opened KCOV slots for syzkaller delayed-KCOV parity without silent uncovered worker threads. (2) all syscalls incl. syz_* pseudo are enabled (production parity — captured programs use syz_* helpers; the default empty enable_syscalls whitelist enables every call). (3) channel.vm.qemu.mem=4096 (match syz-manager capture VM shape; prior 2048 has triggered OOM/resource-leak symptoms during long runs). (4) distinct ivshmem path/socket to avoid colliding with the baseline config when both VMs run concurrently. (5) work_dir under run/cova so the qemu serial.sock path stays under the 108-byte UNIX socket limit. intra_task_mode is explicitly threaded to match captured syz-manager threaded requests.

fuzzer._exec_timeout_comment: [2026-05-24] 5000ms = syzkaller Program timeout (sys/targets/targets.go:860 base 5s × Scale=min(slowdown,3)) at slowdown=1. reFuzz 跑 QEMU -enable-kvm + x86_64/x86_64,pkg/mgrconfig/load.go:242 判 slowdown=1(只有 -accel tcg / 跨架构 / gVisor-race 才 10;KASAN 不提升)。executor.cc:881 强制 program_timeout > syscall_timeout,与 per_call_timeout_ms=50 配套。原 2000 无 syzkaller 依据且 < 旧 per_call 5000,违反该 invariant 导致 blocking FUSE program 被 watchdog 截断。

target._thread_count_comment: 32 is the upper bound enforced by config_parser (matches syzkaller kMaxThreads). Bumped 8 → 32 on 2026-05-19 after observing 38/860 mount-image calls hit reFuzz's KernelThreadPool 'all threads busy' path → flag bit kCallFlagBlocked + skip (kernel_wire_driver.cpp:1257), surfacing as 100% mount_image wire-flag mismatch on the smoke. With 32 threads the pool fans out to syzkaller's own upper bound, eliminating the artificial Blocked-flag emission while keeping memory bounded (N × per_thread_kcov mmap = ~128 MiB max).
target._aligned_with_phase5_comment: [2026-05-20] 把 phase5_threaded_sample_config.json 里 4 个跟 worker 调度 + KCOV 池 + per-syscall timeout 相关的字段补齐,避免 oracle smoke 跑出来的数据被 phase5 性能测试侧的 C++ default 漂移污染。phase5 是 perf 测试主战场,oracle config 需独立显式声明同样的值。
target._intra_task_mode_comment: [Epic 7 PR-4.6] 'threaded' = channel dispatcher 给每个 outgoing task OR 上 TASK_FLAG_INTRA_THREADED,worker driver 走 ExecuteThreaded → KernelThreadPool 调度。要求 thread_count > 1。oracle 收的 trace 里捕获了原始 syz-manager 下发的 INTRA_THREADED 标记,这里显式 threaded 跟 production parity 对齐。
target._kcov_pool_comment: [当前版本 threaded-kcov-parity] cova 真实 threaded workload 用 thread_count=32 作为 logical executor 上限;kcov_collector_count=8 对齐 syzkaller kCoverOptimizedCount opened KCOV fd 上限。如果需要 coverage 的线程没有 kcov fd,syzkaller 会 fail,reFuzz 调度层也不会静默无覆盖执行。kcov_premap_count=3 对齐 kCoverOptimizedPreMmap,其余 collector 首次 Begin 时 lazy mmap。
target._per_call_timeout_comment: [2026-05-24] 50ms = syzkaller Syscall blocked 阈值 (sys/targets/targets.go:857 base 50ms × slowdown) at slowdown=1。reFuzz QEMU -enable-kvm x86_64/x86_64 → slowdown=1 (load.go:242)。executor.cc:1103 per-call wait = syscall_timeout + call.attrs.timeout×slowdown;超过即标 blocked 但不杀,threaded 继续调度下个 call(对 FUSE: openat$dir blocked 50ms 后 yield,让 syz_fuse_handle_req 服务 /dev/fuse 请求)。配 exec_timeout_ms=5000 满足 executor.cc:881 program>syscall invariant。原 5000 是 executor stdio fallback 值,非 manager fuzz 路径。
